content.text:
This is a **hosted job-search MCP**, not an applicant-tracking API. Live, OAuth-gated, aimed at Claude.

**What it is**

[ATS MCP](https://ats-mcp-production.up.railway.app/setup) indexes public Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby boards and lets an assistant search them. Setup page claim: **241,000+ jobs across 8,700+ companies**. Example: “Find me PM jobs at AI companies in NYC.”

It does **not** apply, store resumes, or talk to employer ATS admin APIs. Same public board feeds kuchup already scrapes.

**Auth**

`/mcp` is not public. A probe returns `401` with:

```
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://ats-mcp-production.up.railway.app/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource"
```

That is MCP OAuth 2.1:

- Authorization code + PKCE (`S256`)
- Dynamic client registration at `/oauth/register`
- Clerk for Google / email / phone / GitHub
- Scopes: `openid`, `email`, `profile`
- Access tokens expire in 7 days

Health check at `/` is public (`{"status":"ok"}`). Tool listing needs a signed-in client.

**Tools (from their privacy policy, not a live `tools/list`)**

- `search_jobs`
- `list_companies`
- Per-user “new jobs since” timestamps

**Ops**

| Piece | Detail |
|---|---|
| Host | Railway |
| Auth | Clerk |
| DB | Supabase Postgres |
| Tracing | Langfuse |
| Refresh | every 4 hours |
| Limits | 30 req/min, 500/day per user |
| Cost | free; ToS forbids bulk scrape / resale |
| Support | atsmcp.support@gmail.com |

**Vs kuchup**

Kuchup’s MCP (`user-kuchup`) is an **application workspace**: catalog, JD ingest, reframe, TeX/PDF, apply state. This server is a **cross-company search index**.

Overlap is the data source (Greenhouse / Lever / Ashby). Difference is product: they search a big public index; you own a personal pipeline (countries, companies, fetch, board, tailoring).

Connecting it in Cursor would add “what’s open at company X / in city Y” without putting those companies in the kuchup catalog first. It would not replace fetch, ATS detection, or `add_company` / `add_position`.

I did not complete OAuth, so I have not seen the full tool schemas. If you want, next step is either add it as a Cursor MCP (Clerk login) and dump the live tools, or map whether any of their search behavior is worth copying into kuchup.

content.text:
Yes — as a **lookup while adding**, not as something baked into kuchup’s server.

Kuchup `add_company` still needs a `careers_url`. ATS MCP already has vendor + slug for ~8k Greenhouse / Lever / Ashby companies. Kuchup already turns that into a board URL:

```753:765:relocation_jobs/core/ats_detection.py
def guess_ats_url_from_name(ats_type: str, company_name: str) -> str:
    slug = _company_slug(company_name)
    ...
        "greenhouse": lambda s: f"https://boards.greenhouse.io/{s}",
        "ashby": lambda s: f"https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/{s}",
        "lever": lambda s: f"https://jobs.lever.co/{s}",
```

With their slug, skip the guess: `greenhouse` + `anthropic` → `https://boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic`. Then call kuchup `add_company` as today.

**Do that in the agent, not in the kuchup backend.** ATS MCP is Clerk OAuth, 500 calls/day, 7-day tokens, and their ToS forbids bulk extraction. The EC2 fetch worker cannot depend on your Cursor login.

Flow when you say “add X”:

1. ATS MCP `list_companies(search=X)`
2. Build the jobs URL from `ats_vendor` + `company_slug`
3. Kuchup `add_company(name, careers_url, ats=vendor)`

If they’re not in that index (Personio, Workable, Teamtailor, custom careers page), fall back to the current URL / detect path.

I would **not** copy their directory into Postgres or make kuchup call Railway. That fights ponytail and their ToS.

From now on I can do this lookup automatically when you add a company. If you want it written into the MCP skill so every agent does it, say so — that’s a skill note, not a kuchup code change.

content.text:
**Yes, for you as the only panel user.** Not as a real multi-user kuchup feature.

The lookup is easy. ATS MCP already returns `ats_vendor` + `company_slug` from a name. Kuchup already turns that into a board URL. Then the existing add path (detect, relocate.me, upsert) stays the same. Careers URL becomes optional; if it’s blank, resolve from the name.

What is **not** free:

**1. Cursor login is not the panel login.**  
Auth in this chat does not reach `apps/panel` or EC2. The backend would need its own Bearer token in gitignored env, and a way to refresh it. Their OAuth only lists `authorization_code` — no refresh token — so every ~7 days someone has to sign in again. 500/day is fine for adding companies; expiry is the actual tax.

**2. Name-only is not always unique.**  
“Mercury”, “Meta”, “Stripe” can return several rows. The dialog still needs a picker, or a URL fallback.

**3. Coverage is Greenhouse / Lever / Ashby only.**  
Personio, Workable, Teamtailor, custom careers pages still need a URL. The field gets optional, not removed.

**4. Don’t call this on every fetch.**  
One `list_companies` per add. Cache the hit in your catalog (you already have `KNOWN_ATS`). Miss → ask for URL.

So: **feasible as “Amin types a name, kuchup fills the jobs URL.”** Not feasible as “any kuchup.com user adds by name” unless they all share your token and quota.

If you want that, the smallest shape is:

- Panel: name required, URL optional  
- On submit with no URL: MCP `list_companies(search=name)` → build URL → current `add_company`  
- Token in env; 401 → “reconnect ATS directory”  
- 0 hits or many hits → keep the URL field

Say if that’s the UX you want and I’ll implement that lazy version.

<timestamp>Wednesday, Sep 16, 2026, 3:29 PM (UTC+4)</timestamp>
<user_query>
what if we get the data for the companies as a night job and put into a new table and after 7 days we have lots of companies url and then i will reauthorize it and again we will complete this flow.

and thus we have all the data localized in our db every user can use this tool to add data.

what do you think about this?
</user_query>

The **goal** is right: a local name → jobs-URL table so every kuchup user can add by name. The **source** is the part I would not do.

A nightly dump from ATS MCP is bulk extraction of their mapping database. Their ToS forbids that. Rate limits and a 7-day token don’t make it a licensed dataset. If they revoke the token or change the API, the job dies, and you have a table you can’t legally refresh.

You also don’t need seven nights. `list_companies` already browses their index (limit goes to a few hundred). Tag/stage paging would pull most of the ~8k rows in one run. “Accumulate until expiry” is just a slow copy of their directory.

What you actually want is a bigger `KNOWN_ATS`: `display_name` / aliases → `ats_vendor` + `slug` → careers URL. Job listings don’t belong in that table. Boards change slowly; you resolve the URL once, then kuchup fetches as it does today.

**Do this instead:**

1. **Local table** — yes. e.g. `company_board_directory(name, slug, ats, careers_url, confirmed_at)`.
2. **Fill it from public board APIs**, not from ATS MCP. Greenhouse / Lever / Ashby already expose the same boards. Slugify the name, probe the three APIs, store the hit. That is the same data, from the vendors, with no OAuth and no 500/day cap.
3. **Grow it on add.** Every successful add writes the row. Next user typing that name skips the probe.
4. **Nightly job (optional)** — re-check *your* rows still 200, or probe a small backlog of names. Don’t scrape someone else’s index.

ATS MCP stays useful as a **manual** lookup when a slug isn’t the company name. One `list_companies` call when you add a weird one is fine. Copying the whole directory is not.

Name-only add for all users then becomes: look up local table → if miss, probe public APIs → if still miss, ask for URL.

If you want that, the next decision is only the table + “URL optional, resolve from name” on add — no ATS MCP in the worker. Say go and I’ll ship that lazy version.

<user_query>
what do you mean?
you mean that this is an authorized original solution to dump these ats data from their origin?
</user_query>

No. You cannot dump “all ATS companies” from Greenhouse / Lever / Ashby in one job. Those vendors do **not** publish a customer list.

Two different things got mixed:

**1. Public job-board APIs (the original source)**  
Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby expose endpoints so careers pages and job sites can list **one company’s** open roles. Example: if you already know the slug `anthropic`, Greenhouse will answer `GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/anthropic/jobs`. No key. That’s the official board for that company.

That is **not** “download every company.” There is no `GET /all-boards`. ATS MCP’s own docs say the vendors don’t ship a directory.

**2. ATS MCP’s mapping table**  
They spent time figuring out *which* slug belongs to *which* name (8k rows). `list_companies("Anthropic") → greenhouse + anthropic` is **their** index. A nightly copy of that index is taking their dataset, not talking to Greenhouse.

So:

| Want | Allowed-ish | Not |
|---|---|---|
| User types “Anthropic”, you probe GH/Lever/Ashby with slug `anthropic`, store the URL that 200s | Using the vendor’s public board API for that company | |
| Nightly pull of ATS MCP’s 8k name→slug rows into kuchup | | Their ToS (bulk extraction) |
| One shot “give me every Greenhouse customer” from Greenhouse | | Doesn’t exist |

**What I meant for kuchup:** when someone adds a company **by name**, slugify it, hit the three public APIs, and if one responds, save `name → careers_url` in **your** table. Next time it’s local. You grow a directory from real adds, from the vendors, not by cloning ATS MCP.

Slugs that aren’t the company name (`stripe` vs `stripelondon`) still miss. Then you paste a URL, or do a one-off ATS MCP lookup — not a dump.

Short version: public APIs = look up **one** board you can already guess. ATS MCP = a phone book they built. Use the first. Don’t copy the phone book.
